parameters.content:
## TendGoogle12
**Purpose:** Read-only sync of the chosen Google Calendars.

**Inputs:** Schedule or manual run; Calendar API with read-only scope.

**Outputs:** Events handed to sub-workflow 13; a saved sync cursor.

**Privacy:** Read-only scope, chosen calendars only. Private lane: no execution data is saved (success and error), so provider text never lands in n8n history.
